areas.name: Scottsdale
areas.blurb: Guard-gated golf estates, Old Town nightlife, and the Chaparral Park & 85250 corridor.

areas.name: Arcadia
areas.blurb: Citrus-grove estate lots beneath Camelback Mountain, mid-century ranches, and destination dining.

areas.name: Arcadia Lite
areas.blurb: Arcadia's walkable charm at a more attainable price point, steps from Camelback & Indian School dining.

areas.name: Central Phoenix
areas.blurb: Historic districts like Willo & Encanto-Palmcroft, walkable to Roosevelt Row and the Biltmore corridor.
